Question 5
?

Find the first four non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of 21+4x2.

a
21+4x2=2+8x−32x2−128x6⋯
b
21+4x2=2−8x2+32x4−128x6+⋯
c
21+4x2=1−4x2+16x4−56x6+⋯
d
21+4x2=2−8x+32x2+56x6+⋯
e
21+4x2=2+8x2−32x4+128x6⋯
